title: Turnip's Recrafting Carpets
description: Craft carpets back into full wool blocks!
body:
# Turnip's Recrafting Carpets
Ever accidentally crafted your entire wool supply into carpets with no way back? This datapack adds a simple crafting recipe that lets you recover wool from carpets: just place four carpets of the same colour in a crafting grid to reclaim one wool block.
Fully vanilla and survival-friendly! No mods required, just drop it in your datapacks folder and go.

## Features

- Craft 4 carpets → 1 wool
- All 16 colours supported
- Both spellings of "gray/grey" supported depending on what language Minecraft is set to
